Hi Marcus —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement at Greystone needs a concise extract from your most recent external security assessment (penetration test) so they can close our vendor MAP by 2026-11-24. Specifically they asked for:

Can you send or point me to the right person? We can accept redacted PDFs and a remediation tracker CSV.

Scope (in-scope): production inference endpoints, hosted API control plane, model storage, and customer telemetry pipeline.
Exclusions: non-production test environments, third-party contractor staging systems, and legacy internal admin utilities.
